title: Claim hygiene: legacy PASS separation, current status, distributed and reproduction wording (NF-1T closure)
note: CH1-CH20: the PASS-semantics audit's label, window, no-effect, scope, word-boundary, unclassified and untracked rules; the current-status builder reading the legacy gate table, dropping its label, reporting simulated execution as hardware, asserting plan-only axes, equivalence, unscoped witness identity or unallocated weights without evidence; the claims' distributed reason losing its software-path-only and plan-only qualifiers or its hardware_executed condition.

mutations.name: CH1_legacy_label_ignored
mutations.find: if any(rx.search(window) for rx in LEGACY_LABEL):
mutations.rationale: a current statement that says the gates are the legacy QTA ones is reported as a leak, so the check cannot be satisfied honestly

mutations.name: CH2_every_current_statement_a_guard
mutations.rationale: an unlabelled 'PASS remains 0' in current material passes as a guard; current AI status could inherit the legacy zero unseen

mutations.name: CH3_label_window_unbounded
mutations.rationale: a 'legacy' word several lines away excuses an unlabelled PASS statement

mutations.name: CH4_gate_effect_any_value
mutations.rationale: automatic_gate_effect is accepted whatever it is set to, not only NONE

mutations.name: CH5_status_document_not_current_scope
mutations.rationale: the current status page falls to prose history and may state the legacy PASS count unlabelled

mutations.name: CH6_pass_count_matches_inside_words
mutations.rationale: 'bypass count' is read as the gate PASS count: false positives drown the real findings

mutations.name: CH7_unclassified_files_pass_the_check
mutations.rationale: a new file no rule covers is never classified and the check still passes

mutations.name: CH8_untracked_files_not_audited
mutations.rationale: a leak in a file not yet committed is invisible until after it lands

mutations.name: CH9_current_status_inherits_legacy_pass
mutations.rationale: the programme status is computed from the legacy QTA gate table's PASS count

mutations.name: CH10_legacy_section_unlabelled
mutations.rationale: the legacy PASS count is published without the LEGACY_QTA_ONLY label

mutations.name: CH11_hardware_from_result_alone
mutations.rationale: a simulated multi-device run is reported as distributed hardware validation

mutations.name: CH12_plan_only_not_derived
mutations.rationale: the plan-only axes are asserted, not derived from which checks executed

mutations.name: CH13_equivalence_asserted
mutations.rationale: scientific equivalence across backends is declared instead of reported as given

mutations.name: CH14_witness_identity_unscoped
mutations.find:
"context": "the witnessed numerical backend, by digest: the "
                       "byte-reproduction witness profile, not a hosted "
                       "runner",
mutations.rationale: the stored witness's 88/88 byte identity reads as true of any hosted runner

mutations.name: CH15_unallocated_without_evidence
mutations.find: not trained and meta_report["real_allocation_refused"] is True
mutations.replace: True or not trained and meta_report["real_allocation_refused"] is True
mutations.rationale: real weights are said to be unallocated whether or not the evidence shows a refused allocation

mutations.name: CH16_device_kind_assumed
mutations.rationale: every distributed report is described as simulated devices, whatever its profile says

mutations.name: CH17_rendered_pass_count_unlabelled
mutations.find: f"| legacy QTA hardware forecast | historical PASS_count "
mutations.rationale: the status page's headline table states the gate PASS count as the programme's

mutations.name: CH18_simulated_reason_unqualified
mutations.rationale: a simulated run's reason no longer says it is software-path validation only

mutations.name: CH19_plan_only_axes_unstated
mutations.rationale: the reason stops saying tensor and pipeline parallelism were never executed

mutations.name: CH20_hardware_executed_not_required
mutations.find:
hardware = prof.get("kind") not in SIMULATED_PROFILES \
            and prof.get("hardware_executed") is True
mutations.rationale: a hardware-named profile that did not execute on hardware validates distributed hardware
